text:
alex: Heads up — publish pipeline red on main. typegen job failed and now release flow aborted.
priya: saw a regen diff in CI, looks like changelog ordering changed which bumped semver detection. short log: `typegen --regen` produced reorder of release-notes block.
jamie: hmm, was there any manual edit to OpenAPI spec?
alex: not from me. I think the swagger generator reflowed `x-release-notes` entries because of map iteration order.
priya: exact error from the publish script: `ERR_SEMVER_BUMP_MISMATCH: detected patch -> minor mismatch with CHANGELOG.md`
ci-bot: build #4821 failed: typegen-regendiff (see /ci/4821/console).
marcus: this is annoying — the typegen output changed deterministic sort order after the OpenAPI plugin bump last week.
jamie: can we force a stable sort in the generator? I remember we added a `sortEntries` flag but maybe it wasn't wired through to the release notes plugin.
priya: quick patch idea: add explicit sort by `releaseDate || title` in the codegen step, then rerun regen in CI. Should fix nondeterministic diffs.
alex: agree. I'll open a tiny PR to the codegen templates and run local `make regen` to confirm.
marcus: also need to update the publish script to tolerate reorder-only changelog diffs — they shouldn't trigger semver bump checks.
jamie: caution: we need to avoid letting actual semantic changes slip by. Maybe compare normalized changelog content (sort-insensitive) and only error when content changes beyond ordering.
priya: good call. I'll prototype a comparator that canonicalizes sections before diff.
ci-bot: reminder: branch protection requires regen diff to be empty for release branches.
alex: opened PR #7891 with a patch for stable sort in openapi-plugin. Ran `make regen` locally — diffs only in ordering now.
jamie: can you also attach the local regen output to the PR? helps reviewers.
alex: done — attached `regen-before.txt` and `regen-after.txt`.
marcus: pushing a follow-up to the publish script after we merge. Will add a unit test for the comparator.
priya: CI rerun queued.
ci-bot: build #4822 started: typegen-regendiff.
ci-bot: build #4822 failed: changelog-check still flagged semver mismatch (line noise from timestamps).
jamie: ah, timestamps in the YAML frontmatter were different — the canonicalizer needs to strip `generated_at` fields.
marcus: ugh. I can patch comparator to ignore known meta keys.
alex: if we get this green, we should add a pre-commit hook so devs don't accidentally introduce nondeterministic ordering.
priya: agreed. pre-commit + CI guard. Also add a note in the DX onboarding doc about running `make regen` before opening release PRs.
ci-bot: build #4823 started.
ci-bot: build #4823 succeeded: typegen-regendiff OK.
jamie: great. Looks like the stable sort + meta-stripping fixed it.
marcus: planning to merge both PRs after lunch and roll out a patch release to the codegen package.
alex: thanks all — saved a bunch of release pain. :party:
priya: leaving a short blurb for release notes: "Fix: deterministic typegen regen to avoid spurious changelog semver checks."
marcus: will follow up with a small postmortem in #eng-postmortems summarizing root cause and mitigations.
